phase: P2 same-information noncrossing MLP/TCN/GRU versus frozen QRF
QRF: frozen P0 seed0; no refit, no selecting a forest seed; neural seed variability does not measure QRF training variability
input_contract: same canonical QRF columns, same 24h history and NWP curve, no extra meteorology/history/labels. Tokens are the existing per-lead rows (24,F); static history/full-curve columns are repeated exactly as in QRF. Temporal networks encode the lead sequence, not additional past power windows or future observed power. Hidden state resets for every origin
preprocessing: internal epoch-selection imputer/scaler fitted on optimization prefix only; final imputer exactly equals original QRF train-only imputer, and final dense values equal saved QRF features. StandardScaler final fit on full proper-training cells only. No calibration/evaluation samples enter fitting
split: proper-training valid days first80% optimization, last20% chronological early stopping; complete-label end before first stop issue. Choose epoch on stop pinball, then reinitialize at the same seed and refit ALL proper-training days for that many epochs, matching QRF's training-label budget. validation_seed/validation/evaluation never used to fit or early-stop networks

architectures.TCN: input projection32, four residual causal Conv1d k3 dilations1/2/4/8, LayerNorm/GELU/dropout.1, receptive field31 leads
architectures.GRU: input projection32, one unidirectional hidden48 GRU, LayerNorm/dropout.1

head: 7 logits: unconstrained base plus cumulative .1*softplus positive increments; clip [0,1], allowing exact physical boundaries and ties. Bias initialized from corresponding training-only empirical quantiles. Raw noncrossing by construction; same independent-level CQR may break cross-level nesting, which is measured rather than silently repaired

training.loss: unweighted mean seven-quantile pinball over valid complete training origins

calibration: identical P0 per-lead signed rolling84 CQR, ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) score rank, complete target_end<=origin only, same phase seeds, midpoint collapse, clip[0,1]; confidence80/90/95. Raw and calibrated arms both reported for every architecture/seed
metrics: same sample masks/regimes/lead/month/season as P0; WIS, pinball7, medianMAE, coverage,width,IS, lower/upper misses; raw crossings and calibrated nesting; no invented full-distribution CRPS
selection: architecture on 2014 validation seed-mean only: among calibrated candidates passing the joint gate minimize WIS; otherwise retain QRF_CQR. No seed selection/ensembling. All models/seeds reported; no new search from evaluation feedback
inference: farm-macro then neural-seed mean, mean/std across3seeds separately; paired circular14-calendar-day1000draws seed20261107, synchronized farms/methods and fixed seeds, missing dates zero-count. Intervals conditional on fitted models, not population/model-selection guarantees
scope: all dates previously inspected; retrospective development. Single fixed architecture and training budget per family, no claim all temporal networks are superior or inferior. Convergence/epoch-cap diagnostics retained
publication: source, aggregate scores, protocols, environment pins, traces and notes only; raw data, per-origin predictions, preprocessors and weights stay local
